relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: DPNP was independently associated with increased levels of MMP-9 (OR 5.8, 95% CI 1.7–19.4, p = 0.004)

relationships.subject: Oxidative Stress Index
relationships.evidence_quote: In a separate model adjusted for age, duration of diabetes, and DPNP, OSI levels were independently associated with DNP (OR 1.4, 95% CI 1.1–1.8, p = 0.038).

key_findings: Serum MMP-9, MMP-10 and OSI are independently associated with diabetic polyneuropathy; only OSI with neuropathic pain.
IL-6, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta correlate strongly with MMP-9 and OSI in diabetic patients.
